description: Tool to search for products using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find products based on specific criteria like active status, name, or metadata.

inputSchema.description: Request model for searching products in Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

page.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don't include this parameter on the first call. Use the next_page value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.
page.title: Page

query.description: The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. CRITICAL: All string values MUST be enclosed in double quotes ("), not single quotes ('). The substring match operator is ~ (tilde), placed immediately after the field name with no colon, e.g., name~"value". Combine up to 10 clauses with AND or OR operators. Minimum 3 characters for substring matches.
query.title: Query

inputSchema.title: SearchProductsRequest

name: search_products

MarketingFeature.description: A marketing feature for a product.

name.description: The marketing feature name. Up to 80 characters long.
name.title: Name

MarketingFeature.title: MarketingFeature

PackageDimensions.description: The dimensions of a product for shipping purposes.
PackageDimensions.title: PackageDimensions

active.description: Whether the product is currently available for purchase.
active.title: Active

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

default_price.description: ID of the default Price object for this product.
default_price.title: Default Price

description.description: The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer.
description.title: Description

images.description: A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product.
images.title: Images

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

marketing_features.description: A list of up to 15 marketing features for this product.
marketing_features.title: Marketing Features

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: The product's name, meant to be displayable to the customer.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'product'.
object.title: Object

package_dimensions.description: The dimensions of this product for shipping purposes.
package_dimensions.title: Package Dimensions

shippable.description: Whether this product is shipped (i.e., physical goods).
shippable.title: Shippable

statement_descriptor.description: Extra information about a product which will appear on your customer's credit card statement.
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

unit_label.description: A label that represents units of this product.
unit_label.title: Unit Label

updated.description: Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
updated.title: Updated

url.description: A URL of a publicly-accessible webpage for this product.
url.title: Url

SearchProductsResponse.description: Response model containing the search results for Stripe products.

data.description: Array of Product objects matching the search query.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: Whether there are more results available for pagination.
has_more.title: Has More

next_page.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results. Use this value as the page parameter in subsequent requests.
next_page.title: Next Page

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'search_result'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL of the search endpoint, '/v1/products/search'.
url.title: Url
